column1: Luis Arraez stands out as the top pick, riding a strong recent stretch and hitting safely in over 75% of games this season, while drawing a favorable platoon matchup against George Kirby. Alec Burleson offers steady contact skills and a similar lefty edge at home, making him a reliable secondary option. Freddie Freeman rounds out the top trio with consistent season-long production and a solid lineup spot, but recent results lag behind Arraez and Burleson.
